summary: The near layer generally adheres to its role, maintaining content in the lower portion with adequate transparency above. However, there's a consistent stylistic drift from the scene concept, leaning towards a brighter, more saturated palette and sharper details. Several segments exhibit issues with abrupt ground transitions between adjacent sections, and some content deviates from the master map silhouette or the specified beat descriptions, notably introducing unmapped features or lacking visual anchors for key gameplay elements. The overall visual density and general flow are good, but the identified issues require specific adjustments to ensure consistency and clarity for tutorial progression.

segments.advice: Smooth the transition from grass (left edge) to dirt, making it less abrupt. Add a subtle visual marker or slight environmental emphasis around the x_tile=50 mark (mid-right of this segment) to visually anchor the health potion pickup without placing the item itself.

Remove the smaller water gap and wooden bridge. Realign the ground profile to a continuous grassy slope or plateau, as depicted in the map silhouette for this section. Ensure an elevated block or platform is present around the middle to right of the segment to serve as the 'first-jump-introduction' element.
Smooth the transition from grass (left edge) to dirt, similar to segment 2, ensuring a more natural visual blend.

Smooth the transition from dirt (left edge) to grass. While the significant rise matches the silhouette, refine the structures on the high ledge. Remove the archery targets, and ensure any remaining structures (like the tower) are stylized to clearly indicate the 'optional-ledge-and-key' area and look more integrated with the 'forest-tutorial' theme as an overgrown ruin, rather than a distinct man-made facility.
